blurb: They offer boat haulout, powerwash, CNC machining, boat surveys, and boat storage services. They also sell a variety of classic and custom boats, including racing sloops, tugs, motorsailors, and dinghies. Their offerings include detailed specifications and prices for boats for sale and service pricing.
extraNote: Every haulout is charged a $40.00 environmental fee for hazardous waste and garbage fees · Invoicing is done at the end of every job or every two weeks
